using Xunit;
using Moq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests
{
    public class WebServicesTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task CheckModVersion_CallsGetAsync()
        {
            // Arrange
            var httpClientMock = new Mock<HttpClient>();
            var httpClientFactoryMock = new Mock<IHttpClientFactory>();
            httpClientFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateClient()).Returns(httpClientMock.Object);
            var webServices = new WebServices();
            var queryUrl = "https://master.openra.net/versioncheck?protocol=1&engine=1&mod=1&version=1";

            // Act
            await webServices.CheckModVersion(httpClientMock.Object);

            // Assert
            httpClientMock.Verify(c => c.GetAsync(queryUrl), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
```
